attributes.name: Ulkreth
attributes.powers:
The Ulkreth may not be evaded; it is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. If you succeed at a Knowledge 8 check, or if your check has the Acid, Cold, or Fire trait, add 5 to your check to defeat.

If you fail a check to defeat, when you would be dealt damage, each character at your location is instead dealt Combat damage equal to the scenario's adventure deck number plus the number of cards in your location deck.

corrections.corrected_text: On the henchman Ulkreth, change "If the check to defeat has the Acid, Cold, or Fire trait, succeed at a Knowledge 8 check to add 5 to it" to "If you succeed at a Knowledge 8 check, or if your check has the Acid, Cold, or Fire trait, add 5 to your check to defeat". Also, make sure you read this FAQ entry. (Note: This card also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: Ulkreth has me attempting a Knowledge check while I am already making a check to defeat. Do you really want that?
